title: Waves App - Launch & Regional Growth
description: Astroshot handled Waves as a full social media retainer for 5+ years, covering social media management, marketing, digital ads, production, content creation, graphics, motion graphics, brand development, creative campaign launches, TVC, collaborations, and investor story support. The long-term work helped Waves grow into a regional watercraft booking platform with 200K+ downloads, 13K trips, 8x YoY growth, and a $1.6M May 2023 revenue run rate.

title: Trolley - App & Rewards Program Launch
description:
When Trolley prepared to launch its mobile app and new rewards program in Kuwait, the campaign needed to do more than announce a feature. Customers had to notice the launch, understand the reward mechanic, and connect shopping at Trolley with value inside the app.

Astroshot built a 360 creative campaign around that journey, combining mixed reality, full CGI, motion graphics, social-first storytelling, and outdoor campaign creative.

Phase 1: Creating the viral launch
The campaign began with a mixed reality CGI launch film designed for organic attention. The film generated 3M+ organic views, creating the awareness layer before the campaign expanded into education and nationwide visibility.

Phase 2: Turning shopping into coins
To make the rewards idea instantly understandable, Astroshot produced fully CGI animated films showing purchases transforming into Trolley Coins. The films translated the app's reward mechanism into a simple visual language for social media and digital screens.

Phase 3: Explaining how it works
Awareness was only the first step. Astroshot created app explainer content showing the customer flow: shop with Trolley, collect coins, and use coins through the Trolley app.

Phase 4: Taking the campaign offline
The campaign concept was extended into static creative assets for Trolley's wider advertising network, including billboards, buses, outdoor placements, digital screens, and social media.

One launch. Multiple touchpoints.
Rather than relying on one launch video, Astroshot built an integrated campaign around attention, understanding, and adoption, introducing Trolley's app and rewards ecosystem across Kuwait.

title: National Bank of Kuwait - Al-Jawhara Campaign
description: To drive mass awareness for NBK's 1 Million KWD Al-Jawhara prize draw, we created a hyper-realistic VFX spectacle: a colossal diamond being transported through Kuwait's streets, escorted by a convoy of black Tahoes. The piece deliberately blurred the lines between reality and CGI, sparking a viral conversation with over 4 million organic views as the public debated: Is this real?

title: Warba Bank - Waves Wednesday Campaign
description: Astroshot produced a 3D motion graphics explainer video for Warba Bank’s Waves Wednesday campaign, created to clearly present the Wednesday offers tied to their new bank cards. The project covered the full creative process, including scriptwriting, storyboard development, voice-over, and animation, to turn the offer details into a smooth and engaging visual story. The result was a polished banking campaign video designed to make the promotion easier to understand and more appealing to customers.
